name: Sodomy and enticing wives to adultery.

verses: I also saw the soul of a man whom the fangs of serpents stung and ever gnawed; and in both eyes, snakes and worms ever voided; and an iron spike was grown scraped? upon the tongue.
And I asked thus: 'What sin was committed by this body, whose soul suffers so severe a punishment?'

Srosh the pious, and Adar the angel, said thus: 'This is the soul of that wicked man, by whom sodomy was much committed; and through a desire for improper lust, he debauched the wives of others. And his smooth speaking deceived and seduced the wives of others, and separated them from their husbands.'
